# uzc_ssh_key (Resource)

Registers an SSH public key with UzCloud for use when creating virtual machines. There is no update endpoint for SSH keys in the UzCloud API: changing any attribute recreates the resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_ssh_key" "example" {
  name       = "example-key"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")

  # Optional — fall back to the provider's `project` and `region` defaults
  # when unset. A key belongs to a project and a region.
  project = uzc_project.example.slug
  region  = "tashkent"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name for this SSH key, at most 20 characters.
- `public_key` (String) The SSH public key content (e.g. the contents of an id_ed25519.pub file).

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project slug this key belongs to. Falls back to the provider's `project` default when unset.
- `region` (String) Region slug this key belongs to. Falls back to the provider's `region` default when unset. Changing this forces recreation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same value as `slug`. Used as the Terraform resource ID.
- `slug` (String) Server-assigned slug. Used for import and for the delete endpoint's path segment.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_ssh_key.example <ssh-key-slug>
```
